maya: hey folks — pushing my first PR for the kv-cache logger. quick checklist before I open: branch/commit style, squash policy, who to ask for reviews?

maya: branch name I'm using: feat/maya/kv-cache-logger and commit: 'feat(runtime): add lightweight kv cache logger' — ok?

Samir: welcome :tada: that branch name is fine (we use feat|fix/<owner>/<short-desc> convention). Commit message: prefer Conventional Commits format for changelogs, e.g. `feat(runtime): add kv cache logger` and put longer context in the body.

Samir: merge policy: squash-on-merge for small/iterative PRs keeps main clean. For bigger design/arch changes we keep separate commits and ask for a rebase. If in doubt, squash.

Linh: for reviewers — add CODEOWNERS or explicitly request @eng-runtime and one from @eng-platform for infra-adjacent changes. Runtime core changes need 2 approvers and at least one approval from a runtime owner. Docs or tiny UX changes: 1 approver is fine.

Linh: also run the local tests before opening: `./dev/run_local.sh --unit` and `pytest tests/runtime` — catch flaky tests early.

Ashley: pre-commit hooks are enforced in CI: black/ruff/isort + our custom linter. If you haven't run them locally: `pre-commit run --all-files`. PR template in repo root has checklist — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md

Palmer: add to that — check CI matrix badge on PR. If CI fails on windows/linux/macos runners, click the failing job and expand the logs. Common failures: python lint, mypy, or integration test timeout.

maya: thanks! one more: branching vs main — should I rebase on main or merge main into my branch before opening?

Samir: rebase on main to keep history linear and avoid merge commits. We force-push after rebase: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease`.

Palmer: quick handy snippet we paste for new devs:

```
# create branch
git checkout -b feat/<you>/short-desc
# work...
git add -A
git commit -m "feat(runtime): short description

More details explaining why."
# keep branch up to date
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
# open PR
gh pr create --base main --fill
```

Samir: CODEOWNERS: if you modify anything under `runtime/` expect auto-request to @eng-runtime-owner in CODEOWNERS. If you need an expedited review ping Samir directly and add the label `pr:fast-track`.

linter-bot: pre-commit failed on `src/runtime/logger.py: line 42` — please run `pre-commit run --files src/runtime/logger.py` locally.

maya: ack, will run and fix. Do we squash the lint/fix commits before merging?

Linh: just keep the fix commits — the squash-on-merge will collapse everything into one message for main. But please make the PR history readable for reviewers (small commits with clear messages).

Ashley: also add a small entry to the changelog if this affects user-facing behavior (see `docs/CHANGELOG.md`). Otherwise just mention in PR body.

maya: awesome — thanks everyone, will open the PR in ~30m and ping the reviewers. :rocket:
